schema_changes.detail: ADD COLUMN batch_number text NULL, ADD COLUMN serial_number text NULL (no default); then in the SAME transaction UPDATE rows whose tracking_code conforms to the canonical pattern to set batch_number/serial_number from its segments; nonconforming/NULL codes left NULL. Never touch sku, location, quantity, tracking_code.
schema_changes.migration_note: Expand step (PI1-PI4). Single transaction (transactional DDL). downgrade drops only batch_number, serial_number; UNIQUE(sku,location) and CHECK(quantity>=0) untouched.

schema_changes.detail: Contract step: in ONE transaction, DROP INDEX ix_stock_records_location_sku_held (its INCLUDE lists tracking_code), recreate it ON (location, sku) INCLUDE (quantity, batch_number, serial_number) WHERE quantity > 0, then DROP COLUMN tracking_code. sku/location/quantity/batch_number/serial_number untouched; UNIQUE(sku,location) and CHECK(quantity>=0) retained.
schema_changes.migration_note: downgrade (one transaction): ADD COLUMN tracking_code text NULL; UPDATE SET tracking_code = location||'-'||batch_number||'-'||serial_number WHERE batch_number IS NOT NULL AND serial_number IS NOT NULL; restore index INCLUDE (quantity, tracking_code). PI5, PI6, PI7.
